verified_facts.text: COMO Parrot Cay is a private island retreat set across 1,000 acres in the Turks and Caicos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set across 1,000 unspoilt acres in the Turks and Caicos, COMO Parrot Cay is a secluded private island retreat

verified_facts.text: The island is reached from Providenciales airport by a 15-minute drive followed by a 35-minute boat ride, about 50 minutes in total.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our private island is a 50-minute transfer from Providenciales airport: a 15-minute drive followed by a scenic 35-minute boat ride through crystal-clear waters.

verified_facts.text: Every beach house, villa and multi-room Residence has its own private pool and direct beach access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every beach house, villa and multi-room Residence has its own private pool and direct access to our iconic white sand beach.

verified_facts.text: COMO Shambhala has treatment pavilions overlooking the North Caicos Channel, a yoga pavilion, a Pilates studio and a Jacuzzi garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: COMO Shamabhala has a calming spirit with treatment pavilions overlooking the North Caicos Channel, alongside a light-filled yoga pavilion, Pilates studio and Jacuzzi garden.

verified_facts.text: The wellness centre at COMO Parrot Cay was one of the first COMO Shambhala Retreats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our wellness centre at COMO Parrot Cay was one of our first COMO Shambhala Retreats

verified_facts.text: The spa has an infinity pool and sundeck.
The spa specialises in Asian-inspired holistic therapies including reflexology.
verified_facts.excerpt: We specialise in Asian-inspired holistic therapies including reflexology.

verified_facts.text: Guides lead kayak trips into the island's mangrove forest, home to wildlife including turtles, herons and egrets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us for a meditative kayak into these pristine waterways, where our expert guides will introduce you to the diverse wildlife - including turtles, herons, and egrets - which call these waters home.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary bikes can be used on trails through tropical forests and coconut and banana plantations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the many biking trails that lead through the tropical forests, coconut and banana plantations - all bikes hires are complimentary.

verified_facts.text: Private boat charters can be used for whale watching for migrating humpbacks in the winter months.
verified_facts.excerpt: whale watching for migrating humpbacks is a great option for a day trip in the winter months

verified_facts.text: Dive certification courses are offered in partnership with Big Blue on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: We also have dive certification courses in partnership with Big Blue upon request.

verified_facts.text: COMO Parrot Cay was designed by British interior decorator Keith Hobbs, combining a relaxed beach house aesthetic with a contemporary style.
verified_facts.excerpt: COMO Parrot Cay was designed by British interior decorator Keith Hobbs, combining between a relaxed beach house aesthetic with a soothing contemporary style.

verified_facts.text: COMO Beach Club has direct beach access, two pools, daybeds and towels.
verified_facts.excerpt: COMO Beach Club: direct beach access, two pools (main and adults-only), daybeds and towels

verified_facts.text: Play by COMO is the resort's nature-inspired kids' programme.
verified_facts.excerpt: children enjoy Play by COMO, the resort’s nature-inspired kids’ programme

verified_facts.text: COMO Butler service is offered in Beach Houses and higher accommodation categories, not in other room types.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private COMO Butler service (Beach Houses and above only)

verified_facts.text: Poolside Lotus serves light Caribbean-inspired dishes by day and contemporary Asian cuisine by night, while Terrace specialises in modern Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Poolside Lotus serves light Caribbean-inspired dishes by day and contemporary Asian cuisine by night, while Terrace specialises in modern Italian cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to tennis courts, running trails and the coconut and banana grove.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to tennis courts, running trails, and our coconut and banana grove

verified_facts.text: COMO Parrot Cay is EarthCheck Silver-certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: COMO Parrot Cay is an EarthCheck Silver-certified private-island resort

verified_facts.text: Laundry is offered but there is no dry cleaning.
